title: Item Glow (Java)
description: A sleek, highly-customizable item HUD that provides dynamic info, smooth enchantment cycling, and detailed item stats right above your hotbar.
body:
The ultimate, highly-customizable item HUD for Minecraft.

Item Glow is a client-side mod that enhances your gameplay by providing a sleek, dynamic HUD element for whatever you're holding. No more opening your inventory just to check enchantment levels, durability, or food stats.



**Requirements**
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Cloth Config API (Optional, for configuration)
- Mod Menu (Optional, for configuration)

**Developer API**
Are you a developer? Item Glow was built to be extended! You can use my modular API to add custom data to the HUD with zero performance impact.

Read the Docs: https://km5777.github.io/ItemGlow/ 
GitHub Source: https://github.com/km5777/ItemGlow
